city_center.name: Faneuil Hall Marketplace / Quincy Market (Downtown Boston)
city_center.landmark: Quincy Market granite colonnade (1826) + Faneuil Hall; the Freedom Trail red-brick line; Boston Public Market year-round indoor farmers market
city_center.notes: Boston Public Market (100 Hanover St) is a permanent indoor market of New England producers, open year-round. Portland ME sister anchor is the Old Port cobblestone district. sources: Quincy Market + Faneuil Hall (en.wikipedia.org); bostonpublicmarket.org.

featured_frontier.hook: New Hampshire maple + McIntosh apple compote over Power Cakes on a clapboard porch, fall foliage behind -- New England breakfast from Boston to the Portland Old Port
featured_frontier.photo_cue: amber maple drizzle on a cast-iron stack, weathered white clapboard, sugar-maple foliage in October reds and golds, granite market colonnade
featured_frontier.signature_ingredient: New England maple syrup (spring sugaring) + McIntosh/Cortland apples (Sep-Oct); Maine wild blueberries (Jul-Aug)

cross_promo.partner: Boston Public Market New England producers
cross_promo.activation: maple + apple compote recipe card, Market Basket / Stop & Shop retailer lockup

cultural_notes: New England breakfast tradition ties maple, apples, and cast-iron cooking to the fall foliage and spring sugaring seasons; sugaring runs late winter into early spring when nights freeze and days thaw (source: Massachusetts Maple Producers Association / UVM extension framing)
Boston Public Market is a permanent year-round indoor market showcasing only New England producers -- a civic food anchor near Faneuil Hall (source: bostonpublicmarket.org)
Market Basket is a fiercely loyal New England value grocer; Hannaford and Stop & Shop round out the regional chains (source: chain regional footprint, publicly documented)

Portland, Maine's Old Port is a working waterfront and nationally noted food scene; Maine wild (lowbush) blueberries are a signature regional crop peaking mid-to-late summer (source: University of Maine wild blueberry extension; en.wikipedia.org Old Port)

design_palette._provenance_note: clapboard white + Colonial brick + Quincy granite grounded in Boston/New England historic architecture (Quincy Market granite colonnade 1826 -- en.wikipedia.org; Beacon Hill brick). maple foliage red + syrup amber from New England fall and sugaring. Old Port cobblestone + wharf timber from Portland ME waterfront. hex values are perceptual approximations, not sampled -- flag for brand-fit review against fixed brand palette.
